turns.text: That sounds like a perfect way to clear your head after a long day of architecture work. Are you planning a relaxing evening now that you're back?

turns.text: Exactly. I'm keeping things pretty low-key tonight. I just finished cooking up some boiled Italian wheat noodles, specifically some fresh fettuccine, with a simple garlic and olive oil sauce.

turns.text: I actually left it behind this time. Sometimes when I'm on the saddle, I just want to focus on the speed and the physical effort rather than stopping to frame a shot.
